page.overview:
What is Otorio?

Otorio is a remote planet chosen by the Padishah Emperor Shaddam IV for the location of is new Imperial museum. It was a huge complex, shaped like an inverted pyramid where monuments and fountains filled the large surrounding streets.

It was the site of an assassination attempt on the Emperor by Jaxson Aru. Three heavy containers, filled with explosives dived from the orbit aiming at the city-museum. With the help of Leto Atreides, the Emperor and a few nobles escaped before the container ships hit the planet. A huge crater was left on the surface after the impact.
